result.idSchemeExplanation: every grype-only GHSA id maps to a trivy-only CVE id for the SAME package@version at the SAME severity (form-data GHSA-hmw2-7cc7-3qxx = CVE-2026-12143, nanoid GHSA-28wg-ghj8-5hjv/GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 = CVE-2026-67213/67214, uuid, qs, axios, body-parser, @babel/core likewise)

disposition: CORROBORATION, not divergence. A second gate would add ceremony without catching anything the first misses on this surface; trivy stays an on-demand cross-check (this record is the repeatable procedure). Re-run when either scanner majors or when an image registry exists (image-scope scanning is where the tools' analyzers genuinely differ).
